title: Best Habit Tracking App
body: This is by far the best habit app I’ve ever used. It allows you to track your habits on a daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly basis.  You can archive habits if you still want to keep them but not want to work on them. It has a reminder feature where it will send you a notification to remind you to complete your habits or complete a certain habit. you can add your own emojis at your own description for that specific habit. I haven’t really used the feature that allows you to break a habit, but it also has that feature where instead of building a habit, you can quit habit or break a habit. I hardly purchased subscriptions for apps, but this is the first app that I purchased a lifetime subscription for. The only thing that made me give it four stars instead of five, is that when it comes to choosing when you’ll be doing a specific habit, you have four options: anytime, morning, evening, afternoon. Sometimes you have a habit that you need to complete twice in a day e.g face care routine in the morning and afternoon, the app does not allow you to select both of these options, therefore you need to select one of the four options and you will get a reminder in the time range set for the selected option. Other than that the app is amazing and I would recommend it.

title: Life changing App
body: Habit tracker is a life-changing habit tracking app that has transformed the way I approach my daily routines and personal growth. With its clean interface and extensive library of customizable habits, this app has helped me build healthy habits, break bad ones, and ultimately achieve my goals. From tracking my reading time, standing desk usage, daily walks, and meditation sessions, Habit tracker has made it incredibly easy for me to stay accountable and monitor my progress. The reminders and motivational quotes have kept me on track, even on days when my motivation wanes. What's truly impressive about Habify is its impact on my health journey. Since using the app, I've lost an incredible 10 kilos, thanks to its ability to help me form healthy habits and maintain consistency in my efforts. The app's detailed statistics and graphs provide a clear overview of my progress, fueling my motivation and making my accomplishments all the more tangible. Overall, I cannot recommend Habit tracker  highly enough. This app has genuinely changed my life for the better, helping me develop healthy habits, improve my well-being, and reach my weight loss goals. If you're looking for a powerful habit-tracking tool to transform your life, look no further than Habit tracker !
